title: Slime Beast Over Hellscape
description: A grotesque floating monster with a large central green eye and multiple eyestalks dominates the scene. Its fleshy purple body is covered in dripping green slime that cascades downward into a swirling, hellish landscape of brown clouds and molten green liquid below.
prompt: A grotesque fleshy purple monster floats in a dramatic sunset sky, featuring one massive glowing green central eye and numerous long slimy green eyestalks with smaller eyes. Thick green slime drips heavily from its body and tentacles, cascading down into a swirling brown cloud formation and splashing into a glowing green pool below, surreal horror fantasy style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting
